python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import qmc
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesRegressor, RandomForestRegressor, HistGradientBoostingRegressor, GradientBoostingRegressor
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
D=pd.read_csv('/work/b3_fatigue_data.csv'); cols=list(D.columns[:-1]); X=D[cols]; y=D.target
models=[
 ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=700,max_features=.9,n_jobs=-1,random_state=11).fit(X,y),
 RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=700,max_features=.9,n_jobs=-1,random_state=11).fit(X,y),
 HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=350,l2_regularization=2,random_state=11).fit(X,y),
 GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=350,max_depth=2,loss='huber',random_state=11).fit(X,y),
 CatBoostRegressor(iterations=700,depth=6,learning_rate=.04,loss_function='RMSE',verbose=False,random_seed=11,allow_writing_files=False).fit(X,y)
]
names=['ET','RF','HGB','GB','Cat']
lo=X.min().values; hi=X.max().values
# Sobol full box plus observed
U=qmc.Sobol(len(cols),scramble=True,seed=123).random_base2(17)
Z=qmc.scale(U,lo,hi); Z=np.vstack([Z,X.values])
P=np.column_stack([m.predict(Z) for m in models]); ens=P.mean(1)
print('FULL BOX candidates')
for label,score in [('ENS',ens),*[(names[i],P[:,i]) for i in range(5)]]:
 k=np.argmax(score); z=Z[k]; nearest=np.sqrt(np.sum(((X.values-z)/(hi-lo))**2,axis=1)).min()
 print('\n',label,'objective',round(score[k],1),'ensemble',round(ens[k],1),'models',np.round(P[k],1),'nearest_range_dist',round(nearest,3))
 print(dict(zip(cols,np.round(z,5))))
# Fix seven core process vars to observed high regime values and Sobol rest
fixed={'NT':930.,'THT':30.,'THt':0.,'THQCr':0.,'CT':930.,'Tt':120.,'TCr':.5}
free=[c for c in cols if c not in fixed]; il=[cols.index(c) for c in free]
U=qmc.Sobol(len(free),scramble=True,seed=456).random_base2(17); Z2=np.empty((len(U),len(cols)))
for j,c in enumerate(cols): Z2[:,j]=fixed[c] if c in fixed else lo[j]+U[:,free.index(c)]*(hi[j]-lo[j])
Z2=np.vstack([Z2,X.values]); P2=np.column_stack([m.predict(Z2) for m in models]); e2=P2.mean(1)
print('\n\nHIGH CORE candidates')
for label,score in [('ENS',e2),*[(names[i],P2[:,i]) for i in range(5)]]:
 k=np.argmax(score); z=Z2[k]; nearest=np.sqrt(np.sum(((X.values-z)/(hi-lo))**2,axis=1)).min()
 print('\n',label,'objective',round(score[k],1),'ensemble',round(e2[k],1),'models',np.round(P2[k],1),'nearest_range_dist',round(nearest,3))
 print(dict(zip(cols,np.round(z,5))))
# Recombine intact high-regime process vectors and compositions
H=D[D.NT==930]; proccols=cols[:12]; compcols=cols[12:]
pr=H[proccols].drop_duplicates().values; co=H[compcols].drop_duplicates().values
R=np.array([np.r_[a,b] for a in pr for b in co]); PR=np.column_stack([m.predict(R) for m in models]); er=PR.mean(1); k=np.argmax(er)
print('\n\nRECOMBINED INTACT high recipes',len(R),'ensemble',round(er[k],1),'models',np.round(PR[k],1))
print(dict(zip(cols,R[k])))
# observed top predictions
z=X.iloc[y.argmax()].values.reshape(1,-1); pp=np.array([m.predict(z)[0] for m in models])
print('\nOBSERVED MAX measured',y.max(),'ensemble',pp.mean(),'models',np.round(pp,1)); print(dict(zip(cols,z[0])))
PY
